This cordless planer exceeded my expectations. It's lightweight but powerful enough to handle hardwood edges and daily surfacing jobs. The build quality feels solid, and the ergonomic grip makes long projects much easier. Battery life is impressive — I can go through an entire day without needing a recharge. This has quickly become a must-have tool in my setup.

Outstanding experience overall.
